A '''clone trooper pilot''' was a member of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] and was present during the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He along with a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] pilots participated in a raid on a [[Water/Legends|water]] treatment plant near the city of [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]] by engaging the [[Vulture-class starfighter|Vulture Droids]] surrounding the plant.

==Appearances==
*''[[Reversal of Fortune]]'' {{1st}}
